slides.title: NeurIPS 2025 NeurIPS 2025, held December 2-7 in
slides.text: NeurIPS 2025 NeurIPS 2025, held December 2-7 in San Diego It is 39th conference (first held in 1987) 29,000 registrants (a 50% increase from the previous year) 5,300-6,000 papers, making it one of the largest ML conferences to date Chinese dominance with Alibaba winning the best paper award and Mandarin being the most-heard language in hallways American frontier AI labs have "gone dark" and stopped publishing research, while Chinese labs continue to publish openly The conference centered on three dominant areas: LLMs, Multimodality, RL; Also diffusion models for computer vision 766 papers on Reasoning research Best paper awards - diffusion model theory, self-supervised reinforcement learning, and attention mechanisms for LLMs One notable award went to "Why Diffusion Models Don't Memorize: The Role of Implicit Dynamical Regularization in Training," Another best paper resolved a 30-year-old open problem concerning the power of unlabeled data in online learning Research contributions from industry labs like NTT (Nippon) demonstrated practical applications including efficient LLMs running on single GPUs, decentralized AI systems, optical fiber sensing with transformers, and AI security through watermarking techniques https://www.paperdigest.org/2025/11/neurips-2025-papers-highlights/

slides.title: Molmo Vision Language Model A 24-year-old researcher Matt
slides.text: Molmo Vision Language Model A 24-year-old researcher Matt Deitke received a $250 Mln personal offer from Meta's Superintelligence Lab Matt was a lead developer on the Molmo project, then co-founded Vercept - a startup focused on autonomous AI agents Deitke's expertise in multimodal AI, embodied AI, and 3D computer vision aligned perfectly with Meta's focus on building versatile, human-like AI systems. His work on autonomous agents capable of real-world digital action represented cutting-edge capabilities Meta wanted for its Superintelligence Lab ArXiv Paper: https://arxiv.org/abs/2409.17146 - 50 authors Official Project Page: https://molmo.allenai.org/blog​ GitHub Repository: https://github.com/allenai/molmo​ Allen AI Blog Post: https://allenai.org/blog/molmo​ PixMo-Docs Dataset Repository: https://github.com/allenai/pixmo-docs​ Matt Deitke's Website: https://mattdeitke.com​ The work shows thoughtful dataset design simplifies training while improving results, offering a path forward for independent AI research Molmo was created and financed by the Allen Institute for AI (Ai2). Ai2 is a nonprofit research institute founded by the late Paul Allen, co-founder of Microsoft. The project was led by Ali Farhadi, who explained that their goal was to make advanced multimodal AI more accessible to researchers, developers, and app creators Molmo project (2024) Molmo is a vision-language model built entirely without proprietary systems - and completely open source Most open VLMs rely on distillation from closed models like GPT-4 Vision (where a close model generates captions for images). This limits open models to rely on closed, it is like copying somebody elses homework Molmo breaks this cycle using PixMo datasets: .. human-spoken captions averaging 196 words (vs typical 11), .. 2.3 million point annotations for spatial grounding, and .. human-verified question-answer pairs . The architecture uses overlapping image crops to preserve objects, efficient batching, and text-only dropout to strengthen visual understanding Molmo can point to objects sequentially for counting, making reasoning verifiable This first-principles approach demonstrates that high-quality human data can outperform synthetic data from closed models, enabling truly reproducible open multimodal systems

slides.title: HRM - Hierarchical Reasoning Models HRM - Hierarchical
slides.text: HRM - Hierarchical Reasoning Models HRM - Hierarchical Reasoning Models Developed by Sapient Intelligence (Singapore) that uses two inter-dependent recurrent modules to solve complex reasoning tasks The high-level module handles slow, abstract planning while the low-level module executes rapid, detailed computations, mimicking hierarchical and multi-timescale processing in the human brain With only 27 million parameters, HRM achieves exceptional performance on challenging problems like complex Sudoku puzzles and maze pathfinding using just 1000 training samples, without pre-training or chain-of-thought supervision The model executes sequential reasoning in a single forward pass and gains enhanced effective depth through hierarchical convergence, allowing it to perform tasks that are intractable for even advanced large language models The architecture consists of four components: an input network, low-level recurrent module, high-level recurrent module, and output network https://www.youtube.com/watch?v=ZgwHaI2C-9s https://arxiv.org/pdf/2506.21734 https://github.com/sapientinc/HRM - open source Apache 2.0 https://arxiv.org/pdf/2510.04871

slides.title: AI Updates 2 Postgres vs Pinecone for AI
slides.text: AI Updates 2 Postgres vs Pinecone for AI Projects https://medium.com/@ArkProtocol1/the-new-postgres-feature-that-just-killed-the-vector-database-hype-cycle-556146ed5961 PostgreSQL with pgvector extensions offers significant advantages over Pinecone for most AI projects, primarily due to lower costs and comparable or better performance Recent benchmarks show that PostgreSQL with pgvectorscale achieves 28x lower p95 latency and 16x higher query throughput at 99% recall while costing only 25% of Pinecone's monthly price Using PostgreSQL is much simpler. You can maintain structured data, vector data, and metadata together in one table - and query in one query. This simplifies maintenance and speeds-up queries PostgreSQL is open-source and is universally everywhere. There are solutions for all operational tasks - backups, replication, etc. Teams can use familiar tools rather than learning new platforms with potentially incomplete SDKs or documentation https://www.tigerdata.com/learn/pgvector-vs-pinecone Ai Smart Glasses with Chat GPT on Amazon Bluetooth Translation Glasses with 160+ Languages $36 - https://www.amazon.com/dp/B0FBGNK5VN Uses bluetooth to connect to your phone translation app Face-to-Face Translation Mode: You tap the glasses and speak, your words translate to your phone app, then the other person speaks into your phone and the translation plays through your glasses speakers​​ Group Meeting Mode: Both parties speak into the phone and translations play through the phone's loudspeaker, functioning as a shared interpreter​ Call Translation: Provides real-time bilingual subtitles during voice or video calls Real-ESRGAN - Open Source Image Restoration AI used for upscaling and restoring degraded images It extends the ESRGAN model to handle real-world image problems like blur, noise, and compression artifacts using neural networks trained on synthetic data The project supports various applications including photo restoration, video enhancement, and specialized face enhancement through GFPGAN integration.​ https://github.com/xinntao/Real-ESRGAN/blob/master/assets/teaser.jpg

slides.title: NVIDIA NVQLink open architecture NVIDIA announced NVQLink open
slides.text: NVIDIA NVQLink open architecture NVIDIA announced NVQLink open architecture NVQLink is connecting quantum processors directly to GPU supercomputers for hybrid quantum-classical computing The system enables microsecond-latency communication between quantum processing units and NVIDIA GPUs, allowing real-time error correction and control of fragile quantum systems Announced at GTC in October 2025 . More than a dozen additional supercomputing centers and national research institutions from Asia and Europe are now adopting NVQLink NVQLink addresses quantum computing's major challenge: qubits are extremely fragile and error-prone, requiring constant monitoring and correction by AI-powered classical computers The platform supports up to 400 Gbps throughput with sub-4-microsecond latency, enabling practical quantum error correction Seventeen quantum hardware companies and nine major U.S. national laboratories are participating, positioning NVQLink as infrastructure for future quantum-GPU hybrid supercomputers CEO Jensen Huang called it the "Rosetta Stone" of computing , predicting all future supercomputers will combine quantum processors with GPUs Applications include drug discovery, climate modeling, materials science, and training more powerful AI models https://www.youtube.com/watch?v=myx3De15iJY https://nvidianews.nvidia.com/news/nvidia-nvqlink-quantum-gpu-computing In practice, quantum computers are expected to be practical for "big compute on small data" - problems where the algorithmic depth and interference structure are complex but the final measurement output is small GPUs remain better for "big data" problems that parallelize classically Cryptography (RSA/ECC factoring), quantum chemistry simulation, and certain machine‑learning kernels are prime candidates for exponential quantum advantage

slides.title: Google Titans Transformer-2 Google Titans Transformer-2 architecture Titans
slides.text: Google Titans Transformer-2 Google Titans Transformer-2 architecture Titans = Transformers with Interleaved Attention and Neural Storage Titans is an implementation of a MIRAS theoretical framework for sequence models. MIRAS includes Memory architecture, (attentional) bIas, Retention gate, and (memory learning) Algorithm NeuroIPS paper "Nested Learning" - neuroscience inspired hierarchical memory system similar to human cognition It uses 3 types of memory: Core (Short-term) Memory, Long-term Neural Memory , and Persistent Memory (stable storage for task-specific knowledge) Titans can handle massive contexts much faster by updating core memory in real-time during operation , combining RNN speed with Transformer accuracy Titans uses a deep neural network as a long-term memory module that actively learns and updates parameters as data streams in , rather than compressing information into fixed-size states The architecture employs a surprise metric to detect unexpected information and selectively memorize only novel, context-breaking inputs , similar to how humans remember surprising events over routine ones Titans outperforms Transformer++, Mamba-2, and even GPT-4 on extreme long-context tasks, successfully scaling to over 2 Mln tokens while maintaining efficient linear inference speeds https://research.google/blog/titans-miras-helping-ai-have-long-term-memory/ https://medium.com/data-science-collective/google-introduces-transformer-2-0-with-a-neuroscience-inspired-architecture-cf7f0d8836a4 https://www.towardsdeeplearning.com/this-new-google-model-might-finally-fix-broken-ai-brains-74e6b3c985fc https://www.youtube.com/watch?v=x8jFFhCLDJY https://www.llmwatch.com/p/google-releases-transformer-20 https://www.llmwatch.com/p/beyond-attention-comparing-potential https://www.youtube.com/watch?v=UMkCmOTX5Ow

slides.title: Product Management & AI AI-native companies are hiring
slides.text: Product Management & AI AI-native companies are hiring fewer PMs and favor small, extremely strong, T‑shaped teams where designers and engineers handle many traditional PM tasks ( "T-shaped" - individuals who combine deep expertise in one specific area with broad knowledge and collaborative abilities across multiple disciplines. ) Classic big-tech PM patterns (heavy process, “stay in your lane,” lots of docs and meetings) are devalued AI compresses idea‑to‑prototype cycles. PMs are now expected to actually build prototypes themselves Courses and certificates signal little; proof of work and side projects matter most As PMs rise in seniority, meetings crowd-out actual building, so they must aggressively protect maker time or even step back into IC roles, given AI-augmented IC leverage Work intensity at AI startups clashes with parenting or other life constraints, so PMs must choose environments that match their reality Human skills - aligning stakeholders, resolving conflict, reading the room - grow more important alongside technical building The PMs who thrive will show "figure it out" energy, ignore rigid role boundaries, iterate fast, and let prototypes lead alignment Overall, there will be fewer but more rewarding PM roles: faster-moving, closer to the product, and better suited to builders who combine AI-enabled execution with strong influence and honest life-choice tradeoffs https://substack.com/inbox/post/168175609

slides.text: OpenAI's 2025 State of Enterprise AI report OpenAI's 2025 State of Enterprise AI report Significant growth, with ChatGPT now serving over 800 million weekly users and ChatGPT Enterprise experiencing 8x message volume growth since November 2024 The report indicates over one million businesses are paying for enterprise AI products, with 7 million paid employee seats Key findings show that enterprise AI adoption is shifting from isolated usage to structured, workflow-driven integration The primary constraints are no longer model performance or tooling but organizational readiness Leading firms invest in system integrations, workflow standardization, governance, and executive sponsorship to drive success The report shows that when 20 percent or more of team activity flows through custom AI tooling, efficiency gains become measurable and consistent ~25% of enterprises still have not connected AI to their core data systems, representing a significant opportunity for improvement Case studies demonstrate measurable business results including revenue gains, improved customer satisfaction, faster product development, and cost savings https://openai.com/index/the-state-of-enterprise-ai-2025-report/ https://cdn.openai.com/pdf/7ef17d82-96bf-4dd1-9df2-228f7f377a29/the-state-of-enterprise-ai_2025-report.pdf

slides.text: Agentive - AI for Auditors Agentive - AI-powered audit workflow automation Founded by Danny Albertson to help auditors automate the tedious parts of audit work, particularly test of details procedures Agentive is purpose-built to help auditors request evidence from clients and automatically test that evidence using AI The platform integrates directly into the audit workflow - when clients upload documents, AI agents automatically run pre-defined audit procedures and provide answers with citations within 60 seconds This differs from generic AI assistants by embedding automation directly into the PBC (Prepared By Client) list and testing workflow AI's improved ability to perform "function calling"allowed AI to independently work on complex tasks for extended periods, evaluate its own output, and decide next steps without constant human supervision Agentive offers 2.5-hour training sessions where potential customers can actually use the product hands-on In five years, Danny envisions junior auditors spending significantly less time on low-risk test of details work and more time on strategic discussions, audit planning, and higher-risk areas. AI agents will handle the preparation work while humans focus on review, professional judgment, and client relationships Danny's strongest opinion: firms shouldn't sign three-year software contracts without trying the product first. He criticizes vendors that oversell capabilities and lock customers into long-term commitments based on demo presentations rather than actual product experience https://www.youtube.com/watch?v=yR0ionORpEI https://www.goagentive.com

slides.title: US AI Regulations - Federal & State Trump
slides.text: US AI Regulations - Federal & State Trump signs (Dec 12) an executive order establishing federal-level AI regulation to prevent states from creating conflicting rules He argues that allowing 50 states to independently regulate AI would harm American competitiveness in the global AI race David Sacks, Trump's AI advisor, provides the legal rationale: AI development spans multiple states through training, inference, and internet delivery, making it interstate commerce under federal jurisdiction Over 1,200 AI bills have been introduced across state legislatures with 100 already passed, creating regulatory complexity The executive order would preempt state laws through an AI Litigation Task Force challenging state regulations in court Sacks argues this prevents regulatory capture that benefits only large companies while harming startups unable to navigate 50 different compliance regimes The framework excludes child safety laws, local infrastructure decisions, and copyright issues, which remain under existing jurisdictions https://www.youtube.com/watch?v=g-v8RgL4ToI
